name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
🛡️ Cyber Aurora Bottom Drawer Fix: Resolved bottom sheet staying visible/cut off in Aurora glass mode
🏷️ Dynamic Settings Version: Version badge now always accurately mirrors installed APK version from system
💾 Automatic Download Folder Backup: Downloaded APK updates are automatically saved to your phone's 'Download/MediaFetch/' directory
💎 Whole-App Liquid Glassmorphism & Cyber Aurora Prism UI
🚀 Direct In-App APK Updater with live download progress & 1-tap installation
